fix.description: In UsersService.update, only include fields that are present in the DTO. For photo, add it to the payload only when updateUserDto.photo !== undefined, after resolving and validating the file. Alternatively, pass the cloned DTO straight through, as in `this.usersRepository.update(id, clonedPayload)`, and don't list every field explicitly. That way an omitted photo keeps the existing value. Make the repository merge ignore undefined keys.
